documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Submission Of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong second-quarter performance for FY27, marked by record highs in quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT driven by healthy end-user demand and favorable product mix. The company's expansion plans, including the Dahej greenfield project and Naidupeta brownfield expansion, are progressing well to support future demand through FY28 and FY29. Management highlighted their unique position as India's largest zinc recycling company and a leading green chemical manufacturer, with a growing focus on non-rubber applications and specialized grades. Furthermore, the company maintains a robust balance sheet with a net cash surplus and confidence in sustained long-term growth. J.G.

guidance.claim: Management is confident that the EBITDA margin will be closer to 14% to 15% in the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: So I think on a blended basis, we are confident that in the next 3 years or so, we should be closer to the 14% to 15% EBITDA margin with the share of value-added products increasing.

guidance.claim: The company targets to achieve a revenue of INR900 crores from the Dahej plant during FY29 to FY30.
guidance.quote: I think the INR900 crores that you're talking about should be closer to FY29 to FY '30, that's the period in which we should be able to achieve this number.

guidance.claim: The company expects EBITDA margins to reach 14% to 15% in the future as the share of value-added products increases.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

guidance.claim: Management targets a utilization level of 50% to 60% for the Dahej plant in the next financial year.
guidance.quote: But I would say when we talk about next financial year, which is the first full year of operations, we should be looking at minimum 50% to 60%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the tire demand remains strong and they are seeing very strong traction from tire customers.
demand_outlook.quote: So we are seeing very, very strong traction from our tire customers. They are, in fact, seeing that from the OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they are witnessing strong demand across all customer end-user applications in Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Even currently in Q3, we are witnessing strong demand across all our customer end-user applications, and we are confident of surpassing the numbers achieved till now.

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand and volume growth across vehicle categories.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately 25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire and rubber industry remained robust through Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing encouraging traction in non-rubber segments like pharmaceuticals, ceramics, and specialty chemicals.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project comprises approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum of zinc oxide capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1, comprising approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000-plus metric tons facility, is nearing completion now with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at Naidupeta is expected to add approximately 5,000 metric tons to existing manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: The project is expected to add approximately 5,000 metric tons to our existing manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej and Naidupeta expansions are expected to increase total zinc oxide capacity to approximately 79,900 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Together with Dahej and Naidupeta expansions are expected to increase our total zinc oxide capacity to approximately 79,900 tons per annum, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and '29.

capex_expansion.claim: BDJ Oxides Private Limited acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in Tirupati District during 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Further strengthening our long-term expansion plan, JG, through its material subsidiary, BDJ Oxides Private Limited, acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in Tirupati District, Andhra during 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Post completion of phase expansions at Dahej and Naidupeta, installed capacity will be over 115,000 tons of zinc chemicals.
capex_expansion.quote: In fact, post the completion of the phase expansions at Dahej and Naidupeta, our installed capacity would be over 115,000 tons of zinc chemicals, making us amongst the top 3 players in zinc chemicals globally.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project comprising approximately 15,000 MTPA of zinc oxide capacity is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project, comprising approximately 15,000 MTPA of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000+ MTPA facility, is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Subsidiary BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in 2026 to support future capacity expansion and long-term growth.
capex_expansion.quote: Our material subsidiary i.e. BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd has acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, in 2026, to support future capacity expansion and long-term growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield project is targeted for commissioning in November 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: I would say, it will be sometime in November would be a good estimate.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR 100 crores in the Dahej facility, which has an estimated revenue potential of INR 900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is expected to be commissioned in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for Q2 FY27 stood at INR38.65 crores with an EBITDA margin of 10.71%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR38.65 crores, up 77% year-on-year and 7% sequentially with an EBITDA margin of 10.71%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at INR361.01 crores.
margins_costs.quote: For Q2 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR361.01 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 64% and a sequential growth of 14%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q2 FY27 stood at INR27.95 crores with a PAT margin of 7.74%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR27.95 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 86% and a sequential growth of 7%. The PAT margin for the quarter was 7.74%.

margins_costs.claim: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY from 9.92%, despite higher energy prices and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY from 9.92%, despite higher energy prices and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: The company's pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.
margins_costs.quote: The Company’s pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74%, improving 92 bps YoY from 6.82%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74 %, improving 92 bps YoY from 6.82%.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains that EBITDA margins in the industry are typically in the 10% to 12% range.
margins_costs.quote: So, you see, we have always maintained that in our industry, the EBITDA margins would be in the range of 10% to 12%, and going forward, we will have higher margins because of higher value-added products.

margins_costs.claim: Management attributes recent margin improvement to operating leverage, higher-margin orders, and cost optimization initiatives.
margins_costs.quote: So, it is a function of operating leverage, it is a function of higher-priced and higher-margin orders, and plus a small amount of inventory gains which accrued during the current quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of almost 77,000 metric tons per annum for zinc oxide.
orders_capacity.quote: As India's largest player in the industry with an installed capacity of almost 77,000 metric tons per annum, JGC is very well positioned to benefit from this consolidation trend going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 10,000 metric tons for zinc sulphate.
orders_capacity.quote: We have installed a capacity of 10,000 metric tons for zinc sulphate.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeded 80% during Q2.
orders_capacity.quote: On the operational front, the company continued to deliver double-digit volume growth during Q2 with zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeding 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeded 80% with further improvement expected.
orders_capacity.quote: JGC continued to deliver double-digit volume growth, with zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeding 80% and further improvement expected.

orders_capacity.claim: Together, the Dahej and Naidupeta additions will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Together, these additions will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current installed capacity is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum once the Dahej plant is fully operational.
orders_capacity.quote: With the addition of Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, and once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum, a scale that would position us amongst the top three zinc chemical producers globally.

capital_allocation.claim: The company had a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We have a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as per 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company targets a payback period of 3 to 4 years for its capex projects.
capital_allocation.quote: Usually in our company, we always look at a payback period of 3 to 4 years, and I think in our past, in the past, we have always been able to achieve that.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted West Asia disruptions during the period.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts have impacted global supply chains for zinc dross.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to start the Phase 2 of the Dahej facility in the 2028 calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: Company's commitment -- so Phase 2 of the Dahej would start sometime in 2028 calendar year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reach the INR900 crore revenue potential mark in the period from FY29 to FY30.
management_commitments.quote: I think the INR900 crores that you're talking about should be closer to FY29 to FY '30, that's the period in which we should be able to achieve this number.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve a consolidated EBITDA margin closer to 14% to 15% in 3 years' time.
management_commitments.quote: I think as far as we are concerned, the company is looking at a consolidated EBITDA margin of closer to 14% to 15% in 3 years' time.

management_commitments.claim: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27, positioning the Company to meet anticipated demand growth from the tyre sector and other end-user industries.

management_commitments.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: These additions will provide capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29.
management_commitments.quote: Together, these additions will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29.
Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.
The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
